answer: Start from history-bound issuance rate tied to clean epochs. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 404 fakes spends 6464 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The summit of the design is public, the reef of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the ledge of honest work is what finally pays. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
